attack_result.quantum_channel_description: Against a lossy toy verifier that ignores qubits reported as lost: give each copy the original qubits the other copy reports as lost; clone the rest.
attack_result.verifier_rule: toy W2: accept iff lost ≤ ⌊0.5·n⌋ and errors ≤ ⌊0·reported⌋

assumptions: one genuine note; the counterfeiter returns two candidate notes; the bank verifies both in the secret bases
Monte Carlo draws a FRESH secret note per trial (never repeated shots of one note)
toy W2: accept iff lost ≤ ⌊0.5·n⌋ and errors ≤ ⌊0·reported⌋; loss flags are fixed before any outcome is revealed
with loss allowed, the W1 value (3/4)^n = 0.177979 is shown for contrast only
data.simulator_caveat: A simulator's state is classical data that can be copied freely; nothing here demonstrates physical no-cloning. Only the modelled quantum register is simulated.
